findings.violated_requirement: The Stop lifecycle must act on the completion gate’s CONTINUE decision when authorized parent work remains. The hook blocks stopping only when progress_snapshot reports an available work item. A task with undeclared obligations, pending review or repair, or missing verification can return CONTINUE while having no work item; the hook then permits stopping before completion.

unresolved_unknowns: The frozen package does not establish whether another active runtime mechanism resumes tasks when the Stop hook permits stopping despite CONTINUE.
